styles.name: Pixel Cluster
styles.traits: Limited color ramps, clear pixel clusters, hard silhouettes and restrained dithering.
styles.adaptation: Set the target pixel size first. Check stray pixels and non-integer sampling.

styles.name: Arcade Pixel
styles.traits: Compact shading ramps, metallic highlight blocks, strong warm/cool contrast and sharp silhouettes.
styles.adaptation: Keep complex texture from obscuring action silhouettes.

styles.name: Clean Cel
styles.traits: Clean variable-width outlines, two or three hard shading levels, broad color areas and sparse highlights.
styles.adaptation: Keep shadow shapes and light direction consistent between frames.

styles.name: Gouache Storybook
styles.traits: Opaque gouache blocks, soft grain, rounded forms and a limited warm palette.
styles.adaptation: Do not carry a paper backdrop into transparent assets. Keep silhouettes readable when reduced.

styles.name: Watercolor Ink
styles.traits: Fine ink lines, translucent washes, local blooms and sparse pigment edges.
styles.adaptation: Control subject opacity; paper white is not transparency.

styles.name: Dry Brush Ink
styles.traits: Bold ink masses, dry-brush gaps, pale ink layers and sparse vermilion accents.
styles.adaptation: Inspect broken brush edges and smoke on light and dark backgrounds.

styles.name: Mineral Fine Line
styles.traits: Fine controlled outlines, flat mineral colors, restrained layering and orderly ornament.
styles.adaptation: Reserve fine patterns for large images and simplify them at UI scale.

styles.name: Woodcut
styles.traits: Strong black-and-white masses, carved hatching, few spot colors and angular edges.
styles.adaptation: Avoid line densities that create moire at the target size.

styles.name: Etching
styles.traits: Fine crosshatching, delicate edges, local white space and monochrome foundations.
styles.adaptation: Reduce hatching density in small images while retaining silhouette.

styles.name: Cut Paper
styles.traits: Scissor-cut edges, flat color pieces, layered silhouettes and slight handmade irregularity.
styles.adaptation: Do not turn shadows between layers into a solid backdrop.

styles.name: Risograph
styles.traits: Two- or three-color overprinting, controlled misregistration, grainy ink and flat shapes.
styles.adaptation: Misregistration must not disrupt UI positioning or animation anchors.

styles.name: Fabric Applique
styles.traits: Fabric-piece silhouettes, stitched borders, soft fibers and warm palettes.
styles.adaptation: Keep shapes stable and prevent stitches from becoming random noise.

styles.name: Clay Sprite
styles.traits: Rounded volumes, matte clay, restrained impressions and soft fixed lighting.
styles.adaptation: The output remains a 2D raster image, not editable 3D.

styles.name: Enamel Toy
styles.traits: Rounded contours, smooth enamel, concentrated highlights and clear material boundaries.
styles.adaptation: Maintain highlight direction without blowing out the silhouette.

styles.name: Flat Vector Look
styles.traits: Precise geometry, clean flat fills, few layers and consistent corner radii.
styles.adaptation: The output is raster art, not SVG vector paths.

styles.name: Decorative Line
styles.traits: Continuous ornamental lines, repeated motifs, varied line weight and limited gold accents.
styles.adaptation: Keep decoration from impairing text contrast or hit-area readability.

styles.name: Rubber Hose
styles.traits: Elastic curved limbs, simple black-and-white masses, rounded silhouettes and exaggerated faces.
styles.adaptation: Distinguish intentional elastic joints from identity or limb-count drift.

styles.name: Halftone Comic
styles.traits: Strong silhouettes, flat shadows, controlled halftones and motion lines.
styles.adaptation: Add lettering only when requested. Keep action lines out of neighboring cells.

styles.name: Colored Pencil
styles.traits: Visible pencil hatching, light color layering, soft edges and varied pressure.
styles.adaptation: Do not attach a paper rectangle to transparent subjects. Check thin-line loss when scaled.

styles.name: Soft Pastel
styles.traits: Soft pastel layers, locally powdery edges, broad gentle volumes and a few sharp focal edges.
styles.adaptation: Avoid uniform blur; interactive objects need distinct edges.

styles.name: Gothic Painterly
styles.traits: Elongated shapes, cool dark foundations, concentrated warm light and restrained weathering.
styles.adaptation: Retain value separation and readable silhouettes in dark areas.

styles.name: Isometric Painted
styles.traits: Consistent isometric projection, distinct top and side planes, painted color blocks and fixed lighting.
styles.adaptation: Keep camera and footprint sizes consistent. Check seams when tiling is required.

styles.name: Neon Graphic
styles.traits: Dark solid structures, saturated rim light, narrow glows and geometric rhythm.
styles.adaptation: A dark preview does not prove alpha. Preserve glow gradients.

styles.name: Folk Flat
styles.traits: Naive shapes, a vivid limited palette, ordered botanical motifs and handmade edges.
styles.adaptation: Keep patterns subordinate to the subject. Do not add unrequested plants.
